messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands in the street, raises one arm to touch her hair, turns from profile to face forward, and shifts her weight while posing.","camera":"A vertical, eye-level full-body shot that slowly pulls back to reveal her whole figure and the wet cobblestone street.","clothing":"A white one-piece romper with a pink, yellow, and blue floral print, cut-out shoulders, and three-quarter sleeves, paired with reddish-brown heeled sandals.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short white hair with bangs, gathered into a small top bun.","identity":"A slender woman with fair skin, shown in profile and then from behind as she turns to face the camera.","scene":"A narrow European-style street with brick and stone buildings, black lamp posts, hanging shop signs, and a Union Jack flag on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright rooftop with cranes and modern buildings to a narrow European-style cobblestone street with brick buildings, lamp posts, shop signs, and a Union Jack flag, matching the reference. The person's white hair, floral romper, pose sequence, and slow pull-back framing remain largely consistent, and the lighting now appears cooler and more diffuse, consistent with the new street environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source rooftop/construction scene with the European street environment from the reference, including its lighting on the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression is fully preserved in every frame is difficult to judge from the provided frames.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin tone appears slightly warmer/more saturated in some output frames compared with the source.
